h: Bruno Fernandes reportedly likes a cryptic post that appears to criticise Manchester United manager Michael Carrick
p: The Manchester United captain is said to have liked an Instagram post that seems to take aim at manager Michael Carrick after he was dropped. The club has not commented.
more: Fans are debating whether the like was deliberate.
United have been under pressure over recent team selections.
